pendingFindings.quote: 我會請他們把時間表寄給我們。
pendingFindings.description: Envíen can correspond to ellos/ellas or formal plural ustedes; no source speaker labels identify the subordinate sender. 他們 selects a third party. That may be a natural generic rendering, and the point itself lists both possibilities, so this is not called a definite actor error. An independent editor should decide whether the source-fidelity criterion instead requires neutral 對方 here.

references.title: RAE-ASALE: conjugación española
references.supports: The conjugation tables distinguish discourse person and show shared plural ustedes/ellos forms. They establish ambiguity, not the right translation or severity.

pendingFindings.quote: 說明原定動作在即將展開之際受到了影響或中斷
pendingFindings.description: The source states the call occurred just as departure was imminent, without stating an interrupted/cancelled departure. The preceding 常伴隨 can also be read as qualifying a typical teaching context rather than asserting a necessary consequence in this source; this is why the finding is pending, not a definite error. Compared with the French wording, this explanation has no explicit coincidence alternative and names this source call as its example. An independent editor should decide whether its scope is sufficiently qualified under the same timing-fidelity rule.
